summary: Fictional example. Writing sessions are interactive by nature (x0.9): most inputs are short corrections while reviewing a draft. The agent works alone only during build and image steps.

recommendations.title: Hand the mechanical publishing steps over as one task
recommendations.evidence: In 4 of the 6 sessions read, 30-40 % of your inputs came after the draft was approved: front matter fixes, image sizes, link checks, one at a time.
recommendations.change: Once the text is approved, send one prompt with the full publishing checklist (front matter, images, links, preview check) and come back when it reports.
recommendations.fits: Yes: those steps need no judgement, and the checklist already exists in the repo.
recommendations.saving: About 0.5 h of attention per article.
recommendations.effort: 10 minutes to write the prompt once and keep it as a snippet.
recommendations.measure: Inputs per hour in Writing after the next two articles; target below 8.

not_worth.what: Letting the agent draft whole articles
not_worth.why: Your edits on its drafts took longer than writing; the sessions read show it.
